Description

Looking to hire a 5-a-side football pitch in central London? Three Corners Adventure Playground is the perfect pitch for lovers of the small-sided version of the beautiful game. 5-a-side football at Three Corners Adventure Playground is played on 3G astroturf. So whether you're looking for a casual kick about with your friends or whether you're part of a team that is a cohesive 5-a-side football machine, Three Corners Adventure Playground is the right choice for you.

The venue is surrounded by floodlights which makes this facility perfect all year around. The lights will be turned off by the facility once all sports bookings have been completed.

The venue is open to the public to come and play on a one off basis. Their pay as you play system means that you can book now and play without being a member.

For those who like the security of knowing you can play at the same time every week without fail, you can make a block booking at Three Corners Adventure Playground. This ensures you stay in the game and keep up your fitness on a regular basis. The very accommodating team at Playfinder will help you with any booking questions you may have. A block booking is a booking made for a set number of consecutive weeks, on average this is 10 weeks.

There are smart and spacious changing rooms available for customers, with well-maintained facilities. This means customers can come straight from work or head out straight after.

If you're looking to travel using public transport, then the nearest station is Angel. This facility has excellent public transport links making it easy for all participants to reach the venue.

**Getting to the venue**

If you use Google Maps or sat nav to travel to the venue, please be sure to enter 'Corporation Row, London, EC1R' to be taken to the pitch entrance.

Enter the pitch to the left of the Playfinder banner and walk down the stairs on your right. The changing rooms will then be on your left and the gate to the pitch is slightly further along also on your left.
